extDescription.message: Downloads and organizes your UDB Aula Digital course material into folders by course and section.

toastReady.message: UDB Aula Sync is active on this page.

dlUpToDate.message: “$NAME$” is already downloaded and up to date.

dlUpdateSkipped.message: There is a new version of “$NAME$”. Your setting is not to update.

dlRetrying.message: Temporary error with “$NAME$”; it will be retried.

dlReadOnly.message: “$NAME$” is read-only: there is no downloadable file.

dlSaveDialog.message: The download does not start. If the browser asks where to save each file, turn off “Ask where to save” in the download settings and confirm your Downloads folder.

popupStatusError.message: The background service does not respond.

popupDiagnoseNotUdb.message: Open an Aula Digital course in the active tab and try again.

popupDiagnoseError.message: Could not read the page. Reload it and try again.

popupDiagnosePrivacy.message: It only contains the page structure: your name, messages, emails and session keys are removed. Review it before sharing.

popupHypothesesConsent.message: It sends at most 4 requests to Aula Digital from this page, with pauses between them. It reads headers only: no file is downloaded.

diagIntro.message: Browser compatibility checks. Each button sends at most one request to Aula Digital, and only when you press it.

error_session_expired.message: Your Aula Digital session expired. Sign in again.

error_not_course_page.message: This page is not an Aula Digital course.

error_rate_limited.message: The server asked to wait. It will retry later.

error_not_downloadable.message: This item has no downloadable file.

error_disk_full.message: There is no disk space for the download.

error_file_rejected.message: The browser or the system rejected the file (blocked, invalid name or no permission).

error_verification_failed.message: The downloaded file does not match the expected one. It will be retried.

error_open_blocked.message: The browser did not allow opening the file.

error_offscreen_unavailable.message: Could not create the background document.

error_unsafe_path.message: The destination path is not safe.

error_invalid_template.message: The path template is not valid.

panelHint.message: Compares with what you already downloaded and fetches only what is missing or changed.

planBig.message: This is a large download (over 100 files or 200 MB). Confirm to continue.

planNothing.message: Nothing to download: everything is up to date.

queuePausedSession.message: Paused: your Aula Digital session expired. Log in again and press Resume.

coursesEmpty.message: Nothing downloaded yet. Open an Aula Digital course and use "Course downloads".

optInterceptClicks.message: Download when clicking a course file

optInterceptClicksHint.message: Saves the file into its folder instead of opening the Aula Digital viewer. Ctrl+click or middle click still open the normal link.

optOpenAfter.message: Open the file when the download finishes

optOpenAfterHint.message: Only safe types (PDF, Office, images, text). Executables, scripts, macro files and archives are never opened.

optHoverSimpleHint.message: a small label next to the pointer

optHoverCardHint.message: type, size, status and where it will be saved

optStatusBadges.message: Show the status next to each file

optStatusBadgesHint.message: New, Downloaded, Updated, Read only… computed from your local index.

optResetHint.message: Goes back to the initial values, including per-course settings. Your files and the index are not touched.

optPathsIntro.message: Everything is saved inside the browser's Downloads folder.

optBaseHint.message: Inside Downloads. It can have subfolders, for example UDB/2026.

optTemplateHint.message: Separate folders with /. It must end with {archivo}. Available: $TOKENS$

optErrTemplate.message: Invalid template: check the braces and that it ends with {archivo}.

optIncludeParentHint.message: In courses with two-level tabs (Unidad 1 › Semana 3).

optGroupByCycleHint.message: Adds a folder such as 2026-C02 after the base when the course code says so.

optPadNumbersHint.message: Semana 3 → Semana 03, so they sort correctly.

optOrderPrefixHint.message: 04 - Semana 3: folders follow the course order.

optNamingFolderNote.message: Files inside a course folder always keep their original name.

optUpdatePolicy.message: If a file changed on Aula Digital

optPolicyKeepHint.message: the new one is saved with "(rev N)"; you keep your notes

optPolicySkip.message: Do not download the new version

optFiltersHint.message: Filtered files show as Skipped. Clicking a file always downloads it.

optExcludedHint.message: Comma separated, for example: mp4, zip

optErrExtensions.message: Use letter and digit extensions separated by commas (40 at most).

optErrSize.message: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10000, or leave it empty.

optIntervalHint.message: From 1 to 48. Only checks courses you already synced by hand, with network and an unlocked screen.

optErrInterval.message: Enter a whole number from 1 to 48.

optCoursesIntro.message: Settings for a single course. Empty fields use the general value.

optCoursesEmpty.message: Courses you open with the extension active will show up here.

optSkipSections.message: Tabs or sections not to download

optSkipSectionsHint.message: One per line, for example: Recursos Bibliográficos. Case and accents are ignored.

secHost.message: Only on $URL$. It cannot read or change other sites.

secOpen.message: When a download finishes it only opens these types:

secNeverOpen.message: Executables, scripts, macro documents (docm, xlsm, pptm) and archives are never opened automatically: they are shown in their folder.

secNoPasswords.message: It does not log in for you or store passwords, cookies or tokens: it uses your open session.

secNoServers.message: It sends no data to any server and has no analytics. The index stays in this browser.

secReadOnly.message: Material Aula Digital only shows in its viewer stays "Read only"; it is not captured.

secGentle.message: It makes few requests at a time (2 at most) with pauses, and stops if the session expires.

notifySessionBody.message: Checking for new material is paused. Log in to Aula Digital and it will continue on its own.

syncNotTracking.message: Not following any course yet. Open a course and use "Download the whole course" or "Only new" once.

syncSessionLost.message: Automatic checks are paused: your session expired. Open Aula Digital and log in.

syncOffline.message: Offline. It will try again when the network is back.

optAutoDownloadHint.message: New material found by the periodic check downloads on its own. Never on the first sync, which is always by hand.

error_folder_not_set.message: You have not chosen the folder to verify.

error_folder_permission.message: The browser does not allow reading the folder. Authorize it again in Options > Folder.

folderIntro.message: Optional. Choose the $BASE$ folder inside Downloads. With it the extension notices files you deleted and does not download again the ones you already have (same name and size).

folderReadOnly.message: Read-only: it never creates, changes or deletes anything. The browser may ask for permission again each session.

folderUnsupported.message: This browser cannot choose folders. In Brave, enable brave://flags/#file-system-access-api and restart it.

folderTruncated.message: The folder is very large: only the first 20,000 entries were read. Deletions cannot be confirmed.

folderWrongName.message: The chosen folder is not named like the base folder ($BASE$). Choose Downloads/$BASE$.

folderAllThere.message: Every downloaded file is still in place.

folderMissing.message: $COUNT$ downloaded files are gone. They will show as "Missing on disk" and "Download all" will bring them back.

dlAdopted.message: "$NAME$" was already in your folder: it was not downloaded again.
